Specification of Intrusion Detection System
Manager
AUTOSAR CP R20-11
7.12.1 Api Parameter Checking
The
IdsM
module reports the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_POINTER when a
NULL_PTR
is not accepted as an argument to a service or callback function. The exact
behavior is specified in [SWS_BSW_00050] and [SWS_BSW_00212].
[SWS_IdsM_02101]
⌈
With development error detection
IdsMDevErrorDetect
en-
abled, the
IdsM
module shall check the parameter
securityEventId
of the function
IdsM_SetSecurityEvent
against the configured security events, and shall report
the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID when an unknown event ID is pro-
vided by the service call. An unknown event is an event that has not been configured
in
IdsMEvent
.
⌋
()
[SWS_IdsM_02102]
⌈
With development error detection
IdsMDevErrorDetect
en-
abled, the
IdsM
module shall check the parameter
securityEventId
of the func-
tion
IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContextData
against the configured security
events, and shall report the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID when an
unknown event ID is provided by the service call. An unknown event is an event that
has not been configured in
IdsMEvent
.
⌋
()
[SWS_IdsM_02103]
⌈
With development error detection
IdsMDevErrorDetect
en-
abled, the
IdsM
module shall check the parameters
securityEventId
and
count
of
the function
IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCount
. The development error IDSM_-
E_PARAM_INVALID shall be reported when an unknown event ID is provided by the
service call or the passed count is equal to 0.
⌋

securityEventId

count
of the function
IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData
. The develop-
ment error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID shall be reported when an unknown event ID is
provided by the service call or the passed count is equal to 0.
